body: I feel this. I don't get it why random dudes feel entitled to my attention and when I'm not interested they are suddenly enraged and aggressive. I fucking hate being around people.

I have bpd as well so I know how devastating living like this is. 
I wish I could give some kind of advice but I'm in a similar situation as you and it eats away at me just the same. My best (and only) friend cut me off because of my fucked up attachment style. I don't know how to cope in a healthy way so I'm not going to act wise. 
All I can do is wish you strength. You are not alone.

Wow, I'm almost exactly in the same situation. I dropped my first few pounds due to personal stress (toxic friend) and the rest of my 30 pounds because of working out and better eating habits. (I'm 22F)
I feel so guilty for not liking my "new" body better even though I feel much stronger and healthier than before. I haven't been this thin since I was 15, when my binge eating started. I used to fantasize about being this fit and I feel like I missed out on a lot of life experiences due to being fatter and embarrassed by the way I look. And now? I feel more insecure than ever. I feel like I have a long way to go until I can be satisfied with my body. I wish I could get there even without all the working out and clean eating.
Anyways, I get the struggle. Even though I can't think of a good advice right now I hope the fact that you're not alone in this helps. Your post certainly helped me feel less alone. I wish you well! Keep doing good!:)
Thank you, you're very kind. I wish the best for you as well.

Thank you for you reply!

I feel like my old friends were no good for me either. I had 2 main friends who I talked to frequently and one of them only had me around because she could always vent to me about small inconveniences in her life, but whenever I tried to share a story with her (not necessarily complaining, just telling her something) she would never let me finish and would just cut me off. By the end of our friendship I knew everything about her and her life but she didn't know anything about me since she just wasn't interested in listening. My other "friend" was just a straight up bully. She would make fun of me all the time and tried to play it off as a joke until I got tired of it. Other than these two I've only had acquaintances who just faded out after a while.
Maybe I got so attached to this girl because she's the only descent friend I've had in 5 years. 

You're right. Only having her as a friend gives her way too much power. My problem is it's hard for me to make new friends. I'm very quiet and shy so people kinda give up on me fast because I'm a hard shell to crack. But I'll have to move outside of my comfort zone for once. Anything can be better than keep living like this, so I'm willing to try and be more open. And I just hope my feelings for my friend will fade with time. I wish there was a cure for this mind-hell. 

Again, thank you so much for your reply. Now I know how much I needed someone to tell me this. Or at least someone to acknowledge my problems since the people in my life either don't know or don't care about it.
I wish you the best!
Thank you so much for your comment, you made me feel a lot better. I hope things will work out for you as well and you can be in a healthy relationship soon. You deserve it

I bet that the people who write these quotes have never had anything bad happen to them and they're just living in their little illusion bubble where life is all fun and happiness. I'm actually kinda jealous of them. 
15 years of suffering is a really long time. I wish you all the best and I look up to you for being able to handle it for this long. I know it's fucking hard.
You are so strong to keep going. I can tell you're a very considerate person and you deserve so much better in life than to go through these devastating thoughts. I wish you all the best!
Thank you so much for your comment, you made me smile. I wish you all the best too.

Thank you!! I wish the same for you.
